title: Video on demand
description: No schedule: the videos you send it (Fetch a URL…, or Send to Harvester from the video's page), from YouTube, Vimeo or another site yt-dlp supports, into one folder, tagged.

name.title: Name
name.description: For the folder and the tag.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: yt-dlp's format: the best video (up to a height) joined with the best audio, into mp4 where the codecs allow, mkv otherwise.
